title: solver: derive contact reports from overlapping face support
body:
## What and why

Refs #203. Contact pressure and the integrated normal force were projected onto the sum of every secondary face's area vector. At a surface corner, uncontacted side faces tilted that direction and understated the reports, even though the assembled force and motion were correct. This is a review handoff pending an explicit maintainer decision on eight moved frozen reporting quantities; completion and green acceptance are not claimed.

Reporting now uses the actual overlapping face pairs' projection normals, weighted by each node's existing mortar support. Small sliding keeps the fixed reference pair's normal; finite sliding uses the current overlap's normal. Pressure, normal force and frictional shear use this coherent reporting direction. The physical `State::normal` used by the friction return map is deliberately unchanged, as are assembly, multipliers, gaps, active sets, convergence controls and limits. Zero or exactly cancelling support vectors produce a zero reporting direction, not a fabricated fallback or a NaN.

The independent regression compresses a unit-area flat interface while including all six secondary cube faces. Actual pressure must equal actual normal force divided by area, independently of the unchanged augmentation stopping gap. The original C-ring regression now also compares every corresponding nodal pressure in plane strain and both layers of the 3D ring, integrated normal force, and existing thread-count determinism. Neither old ring report is used as a reference: the 2D general-contact surface also turns a corner at its contacting end; the 3D surface includes additional uncontacted Z faces.

A small original native command recipe and explanation are committed at `docs/recipes/contact-corner-reports.{json,md}`. No new command, dependency, physical reference, tolerance or ROADMAP change is included.

## Demonstration

<!-- fieldcraft-attachments:start -->
### Attached files

These uploads are complete; earlier pending-upload wording below describes the original handoff.

Capture/source revision: `7f6528611943fef617c18a641cfd1d1f6368655f`.

**contact-corner-reports-203.mp4**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93dae5be-4c65-4ca9-96cb-30d42ec50760

**after-pressure.png**

![after-pressure.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9ce37332-9db8-4d92-884c-bf2db8e6a6ac)

**after-probe.png**

![after-probe.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ec3bbb1c-fad4-4f56-bb37-70fb7cef1de4)

<!-- fieldcraft-attachments:end -->

An exact-head **29.0-second native Windows / RTX 4090 / Vulkan** recording shows the committed original two-cube setup, the readable secondary-set form with all six faces, static compression, contact-pressure contours and an actual node 9 viewport probe at 9.992 MPa. The complete 36-command recipe also succeeded through the native control channel; its four bottom nodes report uniform pressure 9.992283950616748 MPa and the unsupported top node zero. Both hexes pass mesh quality. Deformation scales 1 and 50 and the static-equilibrium interpretation are explicit; this is not a physical transient. The final caption explicitly states that eight frozen Hertz reports await maintainer review: the recording is review evidence, not green oracle acceptance.

Native presented-frame/GPU checks, visual inspection, caption bounds and full H.264 decode passed. The owned app quit cleanly. Immutable external originals are `contact-corner-reports-203.mp4` (1280×1080, 10 fps), `after-pressure.png` and `after-probe.png`. Parent source/body/native visual review, independent original/index byte-hash checks and full video decode passed. The three files were transferred in ordinary-Git artifact commit `0b0f2522a855c5d5418a797d1ad0af426c6ff694`, under `objects/fix/contact-corner-reports-203/7f6528611943fef617c18a641cfd1d1f6368655f/`. Received receipts and actual attachment URLs remain pending; transport submission is not an attachment claim. Video and stills are absent from feature history.

## Validation

Source `7f6528611943fef617c18a641cfd1d1f6368655f`, rebased without changes on mirrored develop `7d9c027d71b2c1ea3395e2552e95f0455a7244db`:

- Full `cargo test -p fieldcraft-solver`: 146 passed, seven existing ignored heavy tests, no failures or filtered tests. The independent cube, mapped C-ring pressure parity, small/reference and finite/current pair normals, support weighting at scales 1e-200/1/1e200, and zero/cancelling support tests pass. Existing flat Coulomb stick/slip and thread-count checks pass.
- `cargo check -p fieldcraft-solver`, touched-crate all-target clippy with warnings denied, fmt and diff checks pass. Individually run rooted assets (377), layers (23 crates) and unit-factors (zero new factors; nine frozen migration factors) gates pass. `cargo xtask affected --base HEAD` confirms the helper embeds this worktree's root.
- Exact before/after full-result QA on the original 2D ring, 3D ring and independent cube confirms every displacement, reaction, stress, convergence record and physical contact force/multiplier/gap/status/penetration/augmentation field is identical; only intended pressure and normal-force reports change. A separate bounded tilted-cube assembly audit covers small and finite sliding, each frictionless and Coulomb: every physical `State` field, complete internal-force vector and complete tangent block array match the unchanged baseline exactly. Temporary audit instrumentation and raw outputs remain external.
- Original ring normal-force reports move from 0.00816041725853901 / 0.005945751845527164 (2D/3D) to 0.009499384811150152 / 0.00949934639419216. Peak pressures move from 0.05816282193004552 / 0.04469019561665807 to 0.08152629750177039 / 0.08152578925910003. The corrected 2D/3D agreement is approximately 0.0004% for normal force and 0.0006% for peak pressure. In the independent unit-area cube, physical normal force remains 9.992283950617677 while the understated report 5.807670897995931 becomes 9.992283950617677.
- Mandatory full default `cargo xtask oracle` ran all 82 normal cases and checked the existing nightly-only case through its frozen fixture. It exits **1 / RED** solely for the eight frozen reporting quantities below. Each still passes its unchanged Hertz theory tolerance; no other frozen quantity is flagged. The existing nine known-failure quantities and nine pending cases remain explicit. No fixture, expected physical reference or tolerance was edited or blessed. The generated `docs/oracle.md` and its exact eight-row MOVED diff are preserved externally for review; the feature keeps the accepted page until the fixture decision is made.
- A fresh dedicated per-worktree native target built successfully in 19m53s; the final frozen-head build succeeded again in 0.36s before capture. No full local workspace gate, workspace clippy or wasm run is claimed. Remote CI is pending publication; the unchanged frozen fixtures are expected to keep its oracle red until reconciliation.

### Frozen-report reconciliation requested

The source cases are `tests/oracle/nl-hertz-cylinder/{README.md,recipe.json,expected.json,fixture.json}` and `tests/oracle/nl-hertz-cylinder-plane-strain/{README.md,recipe.json,expected.json,fixture.json}` at base `7d9c027d71b2c1ea3395e2552e95f0455a7244db`; the new values below are from the full oracle at `7f6528611943fef617c18a641cfd1d1f6368655f`. Both committed `expected.json` files cite Hertz (1882) and K. L. Johnson, *Contact Mechanics* (1985), §4.3, equations 4.45–4.49. These round secondary patches are small sliding: the old reports averaged current full-face area vectors, while the correction uses the fixed reference pair projection normals and actual nodal supports, consistently with the unchanged small-sliding constraint. This also changes reports at curved support boundaries, beyond the dramatic cube-corner example. This is an output-definition change, not an improvement claimed against every theory number.

Pressure values are MPa; integrated normal force is N. The final two columns use the **unchanged public-theory** tolerance, not the much tighter frozen-result band. Those fixture bands are unchanged and still fail.

| `nl-hertz-cylinder-plane-strain` | `pressure_x0296` | 2257.8514097926386 | 2258.099534120568 | 2325.066800691437 | 2.88023% | 5% |

Maintainer decision requested: review these intentional pressure/normal-force changes and decide how to reconcile the frozen accepted reporting values while retaining the published theory references, tolerances and all unchanged physical quantities. This branch does not special-case Hertz or silently restore the old reporting direction to pass fixtures. Until that review, the frozen oracle is red and #203 stays open.

## Known limitations

This corrects implicit contact output decomposition. It does not change the physical friction law's existing normal, contact discretisation or convergence behavior, and does not add quadratic contact faces, new sliding semantics or a new solver. A zero/cancelling support sum has no unique normal direction: its reported normal component is zero, while the full finite force remains in frictional shear when that field is present.

The native recipe is an original coarse, frictionless two-hex static compression example. It demonstrates the reporting workflow and independent flat-interface identity; the original C-ring comparison and physical tangent/force invariance are numerical regression/QA evidence. The eight moved frozen Hertz reports remain an unresolved acceptance gate; the native video is review evidence and does not make that gate green or claim issue completion. Run-specific raw logs, saved models and media remain outside feature history. Actual GitHub attachments remain pending until maintainer URLs are supplied.
